title: Sương giá
about: Round x17 (album 12), the user: "hãy sáng tác album tiếp theo": sleep music in the style of Sleep in the Dark (ngu-ngon), on a less common progression of its own (template 1; after the Content ID matches on plain i-VI-iv-V pieces), slow (50 bpm), pad, shimmer, sub, choir, an improvised box tune, then glass. No drums, plucked string or organ. An original piece.
